title: 福奇在参院听证：援引第五修正案拒答，委员会将启动藐视程序？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: The only conclusion I can reach is that the sole reason he is calling me before this committee
segments.zh: 我能得出的唯一结论是，他传唤我到这个委员会的唯一原因

segments.en: is to get me to say something, anything that could vindicate his repeated public pledges
segments.zh: 就是让我说点什么，任何能证明他反复公开宣称的话

segments.en: that I end up in his words, quote, behind bars, unquote. Any reasonable person who was followed
segments.zh: 即我最终会“锒铛入狱”的话。任何理性的人，只要关注过

segments.en: his unhinged obsession with me would readily come to the same conclusion. Therefore,
segments.zh: 他对我的疯狂执念，都会得出同样的结论。因此，

segments.en: although it pains me to do so because of the respect I have for the legislative branch of government and my decades-long record of cooperating with Congress under the advice of my attorneys,
segments.zh: 尽管这让我痛苦，因为我尊重立法部门，且几十年来一直与国会合作，但在律师的建议下，

segments.en: I will invoke my right under the Fifth Amendment of the Constitution to refrain from answering your questions. Thank you.
segments.zh: 我将援引宪法第五修正案赋予的权利，拒绝回答你的问题。谢谢。
